2608.23067.title: Signal or Noise? A Benchmark Study of Agent Skills in Web Development
2608.23067.paper_summary: Agent Skills are reusable procedural modules that are increasingly injected into coding-agent sessions to encode framework conventions, anti-patterns, and reusable tools. However, because each injected Skill expands the prompt of every query, an effective Skill benchmark must determine not only whether an agent can solve a task, but whether the Skill should have been injected at all. We introduce WebDev-Skills-Bench and use it for a controlled empirical study of 31 public WebDev Skills on 50 Web-Bench projects and 1,000 ordered tasks. The benchmark compares four matched conditions, including a length-matched irrelevant control and leave-one-out component ablations. To isolate Skill effects from prompt-length artifacts, we place only SKILL.md in the prompt while mounting auxiliary files into the agent workspace. Across four models, target Skill injection reduces mean Pass@2 by 1.3% to 4.2%, lowers task completion depth, and increases token cost by 72% to 394%, with gains in only 17% to 36% of Skill-project pairs. Length-matched controls reveal two failure modes: some models are length-distracted, where an equally long irrelevant Skill reproduces most of the loss, while others are content-misled, where prompt length is neutral but Skill content still lowers Pass@2 by 1.1% to 1.4%. Further analysis shows that losses concentrate on easy early tasks, Skill rankings transfer weakly across models, and anti-pattern rules outperform example-heavy content within helpful Skills. These findings recast a matched Skill as a hypothesis about a particular Skill-project-model triple rather than a portable asset, reframing injection as a per-deployment routing decision and making length-matched controls and per-model audits a minimum standard for Agent-Skill evaluation.
2608.23067.paper_summary_zh: 代理技能是可重用的程序模組，越來越多地被注入到編碼代理會話中，以編碼框架約定、反模式和可重用工具。<lb/>然而，由於每個注入的技能都擴展了每個查詢的提示，因此有效的技能基準必須確定代理不僅能否解決任務，還必須確定該技能是否應該被注入。我們介紹了 WebDev-Skills-Bench，並利用它對 50 個 Web-Bench 項目和 1,000 個有序任務進行 31 個公共 WebDev 技能的受控實證研究。<lb/>該基準比較了四種匹配條件，包括長度匹配的無關控制和留一法組件消融。<lb/>為了將技能效果與提示長度工件隔離，我們僅在提示中放置 SKILL.md，同時將輔助文件安裝到代理工作區。<lb/>在四個模型中，目標技能注入將平均 Pass@2 降低了 1.3% 到 4.2%，降低了任務完成深度，並將令牌成本提高了 72% 到 394%，而技能-項目對中僅有 17% 到 36% 的增益。<lb/>長度匹配的控制顯示出兩種失敗模式：一些模型受到長度干擾，其中一個同樣長的無關技能重現了大部分損失，而其他模型則受到內容誤導，提示長度是中性的，但技能內容仍然將 Pass@2 降低了 1.1% 到 1.4%。<lb/>進一步分析顯示，損失集中在簡單的早期任務上，技能排名在模型之間轉移較弱，而反模式規則在有用技能中表現優於重示例內容。<lb/>這些發現將匹配技能重新定義為關於特定技能-項目-模型三元組的假設，而不是可攜帶的資產，將注入重新構架為每次部署的路由決策，並使長度匹配的控制和每模型審計成為代理技能評估的最低標準。
2608.23067.author: Ziyue Yang et.al.
